title: Add External Order References
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-10
html:
Path: /order/202406/orders/external_orders

Method: [POST]

Function Description

If you use an external order management system (OMS), its order and line item IDs may differ from the corresponding TikTok Shop IDs. Use this endpoint to attach external OMS references to up to 100 TikTok Shop orders. To update an existing reference, call the endpoint again with the same TikTok Shop order and OMS. Each order is processed independently. On a successful API response, references for orders not listed in data.errors are saved; use that list to identify per-order errors.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
orders []object Y Orders for which to add or update external OMS references. Min count: 1. Max count: 100.
^id string Y 576461413038785752 The unique identifier for a TikTok Shop order.
^external_order object Y Order information in your external order management system (OMS).
^^id string Y 676461413038785752 The corresponding order ID in your OMS.
^^platform string Y SHOPIFY The alias of your OMS.
Possible values:
  • SHOPIFY
  • WOOCOMMERCE
  • BIGCOMMERCE
  • MAGENTO
  • SALESFORCE_COMMERCE_CLOUD
  • CHANNEL_ADVISOR
  • AMAZON
  • ORDER_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM
  • WAREHOUSE_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM
  • ERP_SYSTEM

Notes:

  • To attach information from multiple OMSs to the same order in TikTok Shop, call this API multiple times, each with the same TikTok Shop order and a different OMS.
  • To edit the attached information for a TikTok Shop order, call the API with the same OMS. | ^^line_items |[]object |Y | |Max count: 100. | ^^^id |string |Y |577086512123755123 |Line item ID in your OMS. | ^^^origin_id |string |Y |677086512123755123 |Line item ID in TikTok Shop. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/order/202406/orders/external_orders?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY

Body

{"orders":[{"id":"576461413038785752","external_order":{"id":"676461413038785752","platform":"SHOPIFY","line_items":[{"id":"577086512123755123","origin_id":"677086512123755123"}]}}]}

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^errors []object Per-order errors. Each item identifies a TikTok Shop order and its external OMS reference that could not be processed. On a successful API response, references for orders not listed here are saved even when this list is non-empty.
^^code string 36020001 The machine-readable code for this per-order error.
^^message string Invalid order_id A human-readable message describing this per-order error.
^^detail object The TikTok Shop order and external OMS reference associated with this per-order error.
^^^order_id string 576461413038785752 The unique identifier for a TikTok Shop order.
^^^external_order object The order information in your OMS.
^^^^id string 676461413038785752 The corresponding order ID in your OMS.
^^^^platform string SHOPIFY The alias of your OMS.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"errors":[{"code":"36020001","message":"Invalid order_id","detail":{"order_id":"576461413038785752","external_order":{"id":"676461413038785752","platform":"SHOPIFY"}}}]},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
